fillSource.ratingSummary: fillProperty on the aggregate display, shareProperty on each level

pointer.press: checks the radio under the pointer
pointer.pressChecked: empties the value when clearable, with the reason clear
pointer.hover: previews the value under the pointer on the symbols, without requesting it
pointer.drag: a touch or pen dragged along the row checks the radio under it, read by ratingAtPoint; the row keeps vertical panning
pointer.halfHit: the half radio is stacked above the whole one, so the inline-start half of a symbol asks for the half value

onPreviewChange.carries: the value under the pointer, or null
onPreviewChange.reason: a hover changes nothing the consumer owns, so it is an event and not a state model

PageUp.reason: A rating holds at most ten symbols, and Home and End reach both ends in one key; the slider's page step exists for ranges a reader cannot cross key by key.

fractions.reason: A third or a quarter of a symbol is a target of five pixels at the default size, below the WCAG minimum; the display member draws any fraction, the input member offers whole and half steps.

secondaryTone.reason: The secondary tone's solid step is a ground, 1.1:1 on the page in light, and a lit star in it reads as an unlit one; a neutral rating is the display of a number, which `typography` sets.

customSymbol.reason: Each item's symbol is the part a consumer replaces through the binding's composition surface; a prop per icon is the shape MUI and Mantine needed because they have no parts.

nps.reason: A numbered scale of eleven points is a choice among labelled numbers, which segmented-control draws; a rating is symbols lit in order.

highlightSelectedOnly.reason: A scale of faces or words where only the chosen one lights is a nominal choice: radio-group with the tile variant.

insight.interval: 95%, normal approximation, clamped to the scale

messageFormat: @slotted/core/i18n message grammar; {value} written by formatRatingValue, shares by formatShare
